Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
More players not 100% sure about card Big Game. Does card said if acting minion Red List him gain maneuver or press or card said if target action Red List acting minion gain maneuver or press?

Big Game
[KMW:C/PAl3]
Cardtype: Action
Do not replace until after this action.
Enter combat with a ready minion controlled by another Methuselah. If that minion is a Red List minion, this minion gets an optional maneuver or press in that combat and unlocks at the end of the action if he or she is still ready.

Messages.Author: self biased
Messages.Body: its worded a little wonky, but if the targeted minion is red list, then the acting minion gets the bonuses

This minion always refer to the acting minion, or the minion with the card (and if it's ambiguous, either "this acting minion" or "the attached minion").
That minion always refer to the other minion.
